name: @equin/plugin-infra-launcher-runtime-env
description: What environment the runtime tree starts from: the declared allowlist the launcher spawns the gateway with and the gateway forwards to its children (pickRuntimeEnv / runtimeEnvNames / pickHostEnv), and the runtime's PATH with mise's shims first (runtimePath / runtimeShimsDir). A core-only leaf, so a tool runner needing the runtime PATH never bundles the launcher's release boot.
